scope: Four separate instrumented cases. Native groups n5/10/20 measured requests, direct SDK groups n2/4/8. Nearest-rank p95 is often a maximum. SDK wall time includes response parsing; Auth HTTP phases do not isolate provider CPU. Process-window CPU overlaps requests; histogram summaries are maxima of1-second windows, not whole-run p95. Role aggregates and representative plans cannot prove per-request pool wait.
